# Yue Wiktionary candidate attribution

Source: Yue Wiktionary contributors, official Wikimedia dump dated 2026-10-01.
https://dumps.wikimedia.org/yuewiktionary/20261001/
https://yue.wiktionary.org/

The retained page footer and Wikimedia Terms of Use declare CC BY-SA 4.0 for
reusable text. Full terms and the source notices are retained unchanged.
Source-page revision and contributor-history URLs accompany every extracted
pronunciation occurrence. Preserve additional source attribution in the retained
wikitext/history where applicable. Wikimedia and contributors do not endorse
this project. The application code is separate from licensed dictionary data.

Candidate extraction selects only main-namespace own Han headwords, exact
langue|yue sections and explicitly written Cantonese fields in pinned templates.
Case/whitespace and documented Unicode superscript tones may normalize with raw
source fields retained. No templates/Lua execute, no definition/example/audio
is selected, no inherited or inferred pronunciation is added. Unsupported or
ambiguous structures remain review records. Duplicate occurrences retain source
locations. Unknown-frequency weight zero is not a measured zero frequency.

This source is candidate preparation only: not selected for the default builder,
current runtime, package, installation or independent linguistic approval.
Kaikki, English/Chinese Wiktionary subsets, and research-only result pairs are
excluded from this selected raw source. No existing dictionary was changed.
